title: Asian Games 2026: Indian athletes land in Japan to a forgettable welcome

On the shooting front, coach Samaresh Jung experienced accreditation problems, limiting his access.

title: AI translation vs English: Viral post by Maths teacher sparks fierce debate in China
content: A maths teacher's viral post calling for English to be made optional in Chinese schools has sparked a nationwide debate. As AI translation tools improve and graduate job prospects dim, parents and teachers are questioning English's place as a core subject. A Shenzhen university is already phasing out English courses, while some teachers warn that dropping the language would widen China's wealth gap, leaving poorer students with fewer global opportunities.

title: Jarange Patil ends 20-day fast, gives govt 3 months to consider his demands

He asked Maratha community members not to follow his vehicle after he left Patoda. Instead, he urged them to meet him directly at Khopoli.

title: 'Deeply regrets': FIDE apologises over Chess Olympiad lodging crisis
content: FIDE has apologised after accommodation problems disrupted the opening day of the 2026 Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, leaving some teams without proper lodging. The governing body said affected federations will be reimbursed for suitable accommodation for up to three days, while teams staying in substandard official hotels will receive compensation. India was among the contingents affected.

title: US denies visa to Palestinian President Abbas for UNGA
content: In a significant move, US officials have broadened visa restrictions impacting leaders of the Palestinian Authority, including President Mahmoud Abbas, who is now barred from attending the UN General Assembly. This action springs from US concerns regarding actions at odds with commitments to American laws, particularly in light of the Palestinian push for statehood recognition through international channels, which has faced consistent US opposition.

title: Josh Duhamel turned 52 Minnesota acres into an off-grid family retreat

Over the years, he expanded the land to fifty-two acres, modernizing it with essential utilities like electricity and running water. This transformation has provided a beloved retreat for his family, where they can enjoy a range of outdoor activities, including leisure time by the lakeside with his son.

title: UP Class 10 students hailed as heroes for saving drowning woman

They managed to keep her afloat while guiding her to safety, where onlookers helped pull her ashore. Authorities are currently examining the reasons behind her jump. The heroic students were subsequently honored for their quick-thinking and courageous actions.

title: Why Mark Zuckerberg's wife's school was shut down despite $125 million in donations,
content: After ten years in operation, Priscilla Chan's Primary School in East Palo Alto has shut down. Supported by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school was designed to provide essential services for low-income families. However, despite substantial funding, student outcomes frequently lagged behind state benchmarks. As the initiative pivots towards scientific research, this closure illustrates the difficulties faced by philanthropic educational endeavors.

title: UP man beheads sleeping wife over ‘affair’, walks into police station

The couple's relationship had been strained for months due to these suspicions. Investigators are examining the scene and questioning the accused man. The victim's family claims she faced prior abuse and threats from her husband.

title: 'Very political': Trump fumes after 1st Fed rate hike in over 3 years

President Donald Trump has called for a substantial reduction in interest rates, advocating for lower borrowing costs given the country's robust credit status. However, officials have stated that ongoing inflation remains a significant factor driving this adjustment.

title: Govt lowers export levies on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel

Export duty on petrol decreased by one rupee to zero point five rupees per litre.  Diesel export levies were lowered by five rupees to twenty rupees per litre.  These changes reflect a reversal of higher rates implemented earlier this month.

In response, India summoned Pakistan's Charge d'Affaires to formally protest the actions of the Pakistani ship and emphasized the importance of adhering to military agreements.

title: 23-year-old Georgia mayor removed from office after misconduct allegations

Now, Stockbridge is preparing for a special election to choose a new mayor to bridge the leadership gap.

title: Indian couple win payout after suing UK home office for 'unlawful' immigration detention
content: the married couple, both Indian nationals, took legal action last year . they claimed being accommodated separately in male and female accommodation before planned removal was an "unlawful interference with their right to family life" the couple also challenged the refusal of their asylum claim in the uk .

title: Gang uses stolen hearse to cart away ATM with Rs 12 lakh
content: seven-member gang from west Bengal stole a hearse and an ATM containing Rs 12 lakh from Koodapakkam near Poonamallee on sept 5 . three members of the gang have been arrested in Kerala, while four others are on the run . police said the kiosk had neither a CCTV camera nor a burglar alarm .

title: At halfway mark of third term, PM Modi to hold 'Chintan Shivir'
content: the two-day Chintan Shivir is aimed at reviewing governance, improving coordination among ministries and shaping the government’s future agenda . the retreat will be held at Seva Teerth and comes almost midway through the third term of Modi-led NDA govt .

title: Aggrieved party can seek deletion of court clips on socials: SC
content: supreme court says aggrieved person could seek a "takedown" order of content . if such footage was uploaded on social media, an advocate could approach authorities . advocate says unauthorised circulation of the proceedings violated his right to life, liberty, dignity and privacy .

title: Meet Benjamin Davis, 16, who turned 3D printer waste into reusable filament
content: student at bishop Feehan high school in attleboro, massa, built the machine as part of his science research project . the system uses waste plastic, including waste generated during 3D printing and converts it into filament that can again be fed into a 3D printer .

title: Never met, didn’t know Disha Salian: Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Aaditya Thackeray
content: 'i have never met or known Disha Salian,' said the Sena UBT MLA MUMBAI: Shiv Sena . he said linking him to the case was a deliberate attempt at character assassination by those with clear political and personal motives .

title: From ‘Ankur’ to ‘Malgudi Days’, Anant Nag’s five-decade journey earns Phalke honour
content: veteran actor anant Nag will receive the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 . 78-year-old actor will be presented with india's highest cinema honour at the 72nd national film awards ceremony in Kevadia, Gujarat, on September 22, 2026 .

title: Hospitals could be charging 2,841% higher on commonly used consumables
content: a disposable syringe available for under Rs 7 has a price tag of around Rs 60 . the gap becomes even more stark for high-value devices such as pacemakers, heart valves and intraocular lenses . such mark-ups ultimately inflate the patient's hospital bill .

title: Don’t trust Centre unless it’s a written deal, J&K CM tells Ladakhi delegation
content: CM Omar Abdullah said ladakhi representatives should not trust the centre on any assurance until it is in writing . he said that he fell victim to assurances that the statehood would be restored, which wasn’t SRINAGAR . the CM also alleged that J&K was assured that statehood will be restored .

title: NMDC discovers 27.29-carat diamond at Panna mine, its 2nd largest yet
content: a sparkling 27.29-carat gem-quality diamond has been discovered at NMDC Limited’s Panna mining project in Madhya Pradesh . the diamond was recovered on sept 15, 2026, from NMd’s Majhgawan mine in Panna . NMde officials indicated that the newly recovered diamond has initially been estimated to have a minimum auction price of around Rs 1 crore, but the final value could rise to Rs 2 crore .

title: SC pulls up govt for 'denying' disabled soldiers their benefits
content: govt says "many disabled soldiers in India are still denied disability benefits on hyper-technical reasons" a bench of justices noted that the report had recommended the immediate withdrawal of appeals . the bench also examined the outcomes relating to disability and pensionary benefits .
